entries.title: VPS Settings
entries.text: Rules the VPS enforces on every launch. Only the orchestrator starts builds: a build launch without the orchestrator's dispatch token is refused, logged under Refused jobs and noticed on your phone. Switching that rule off is your own click.

entries.title: Clear log
entries.text: Empties the refused-jobs log. One line is kept saying who cleared it and when. The rule itself is not changed.
